_comment: 设计稿：AI 回复里的「选项卡」（choice card）与输入框里的已选 chip。全部是注入到真实界面上的 DOM 原型（scripts/screenshots/injects/choice-card-*.js），不含产品代码——它们只用来给 docs/design/choice-cards.zh-CN.md 出样张。

choice-card-empty.note: 设计稿 A · 未选。回复末尾挂一张选项卡：标题说明这是在问下一步做什么，三个选项各带一行后果说明，右上角标注单选。整张卡只比正文宽一格，与审批卡（也是卡片）靠位置区分——它跟在正文里，不浮在输入框上方。

steps.eval: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); if(!card) throw new Error('the choice card did not render'); card.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); const r=card.getBoundingClientRect(); const rows=card.querySelectorAll('[data-choice-option]'); if(rows.length!==3) throw new Error('the card draws '+rows.length+' options'); const form=document.querySelector('form').getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.bottom > form.top - 8) throw new Error('the card runs under the composer: '+Math.round(r.bottom)+' vs '+Math.round(form.top)); if(r.top < 70) throw new Error('the card is clipped at the top: '+Math.round(r.top)); if(document.querySelector('[data-choice-chip]')) throw new Error('nothing is chosen yet, so the composer must be empty'); const t=document.body.innerText; if(t.includes('允许一次')) throw new Error('the approval card is still covering the reply'); return JSON.stringify({card:[Math.round(r.top),Math.round(r.bottom)],w:Math.round(r.width)}); })()

choice-card-empty.variantsTitle: 卡片样式的三个方向（同一屏，只换卡片本身）

choice-card-chosen.note: 设计稿 A · 已选。点一下选项，卡片留下记录（选中的行高亮），答案作为**编辑器内的 pill** 落在输入框里——和文件引用同一个原子元素。所以什么都没打字时发送键就已经可用；这是 v1 的错误：v1 把 chip 放在附件行，inputEmpty 仍为真，发送键恒灰，需求 (d) 根本不成立。

steps.eval: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); card.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); const r=card.getBoundingClientRect(); const pill=document.querySelector('[data-mention="choice"]'); if(!pill) throw new Error('no answer pill in the editor'); const editor=document.querySelector('[contenteditable="true"]'); if(!editor.contains(pill)) throw new Error('the pill is not inside the editor'); const pr=pill.getBoundingClientRect(); const er=editor.getBoundingClientRect(); if(pr.x < er.x-1 || pr.right > er.right+1) throw new Error('the pill spills out of the editor'); const f=document.querySelector('form').getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.bottom > f.top - 8) throw new Error('the card runs under the composer'); const picked=[...card.querySelectorAll('[data-choice-option]')].filter(o=>getComputedStyle(o).borderColor !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'); if(picked.length!==1) throw new Error(picked.length+' options look chosen'); const btn=window.__choiceSendButton(); if(btn.disabled) throw new Error('send is disabled with only a choice made — requirement (d) is broken'); const typedNodes=[...editor.childNodes].filter(n=>n.nodeType===3).map(n=>n.textContent.replace(/[\u200B\s]/g,'')).join(''); if(typedNodes) throw new Error('nothing should be typed beside the pill: '+JSON.stringify(typedNodes)); return JSON.stringify({card:[Math.round(r.top),Math.round(r.bottom)],pill:[Math.round(pr.x),Math.round(pr.width)],sendDisabled:btn.disabled}); })()

choice-card-change.note: 设计稿 A · 改回来。pill 自带铅笔与叉：铅笔在同一处把问题重新展开（浮层贴在 pill 上方，不跳回正文），换一个选项时 pill 的文案跟着变；叉直接撤销这次选择，pill 消失、发送键跟着变灰。

steps.eval: (() => { const p=document.querySelector('[data-choice-popover]'); if(!p) throw new Error('no popover'); const r=p.getBoundingClientRect(); const pill=document.querySelector('[data-mention="choice"]').getBoundingClientRect(); const f=document.querySelector('form').getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.height<100) throw new Error('the popover is too small'); if(r.bottom > pill.top+2) throw new Error('the popover overlaps the pill it belongs to'); if(r.top < 60) throw new Error('the popover is off the top: '+r.top); if(f.bottom > window.innerHeight+1) throw new Error('the composer is off screen'); return JSON.stringify({pop:[Math.round(r.top),Math.round(r.bottom)],pill:[Math.round(pill.top)],form:[Math.round(f.top)]}); })()

choice-card-chosen-text.note: 设计稿 A · 已选 + 补了一句话（需求 c）。pill 与文字在同一个编辑器流里，顺序就是读者看到的顺序；发送出去时先 pill 的答案、后文字（`serialize()` 按文档顺序产出），所以用户气泡里显示的就是真正发出去的内容。

steps.eval: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); card.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const editor=document.querySelector('[contenteditable="true"]'); const pill=editor.querySelector('[data-mention="choice"]'); if(!pill) throw new Error('no pill'); const visible=(editor.innerText||'').replace(/[\u200B]/g,''); if(!visible.includes('顺便把图例挪到右下')) throw new Error('the typed words are missing: '+JSON.stringify(visible)); const flow=[...editor.childNodes].filter(n=>n.nodeType===3 ? n.textContent.replace(/[\u200B\s]/g,'').length>0 : n.nodeType===1&&n.getAttribute('data-mention')); const first=flow[0]; if(!(first.nodeType===1&&first.getAttribute('data-mention')==='choice')) throw new Error('the pill must come before the typed words, got '+JSON.stringify(flow.map(n=>n.nodeType===3?'text':n.getAttribute('data-mention')))); const btn=window.__choiceSendButton(); if(btn.disabled) throw new Error('send must be enabled'); return JSON.stringify({flow:flow.map(n=>n.nodeType===3?'text':'pill'),sendDisabled:btn.disabled}); })()

choice-card-queue.note: 设计稿 · 已选的消息**进了发送队列之后**（用户提的第三点）。队列行今天只有纯文本：`queueDraft()` 把 `editor.getContent()` 交给面板，答案此时已经拍平成 `[接下来做哪一件？ → 重画森林图]` 这一串字，行内编辑框也只能改这串字。设计要加的是把答案作为结构化 chip 留在行里：铅笔换答案、行的叉删整条——两者都不需要用户重打序列化形式。

steps.eval: (() => { const box = document.querySelector('[role=textbox]'); box.focus(); box.textContent = ''; box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'draft cleared'; })()

steps.type: 把表格第一列改成百分比

steps.eval: (async () => { const deadline = Date.now() + 8000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { if (document.querySelector("button[aria-label='停止']")) return 'run started'; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('the run never started'); })()
document.querySelector('[role=textbox]').focus()

steps.type: 顺便把图注也改成中文

steps.tap: 选择如何处理这条消息

steps.eval: (() => { const panel=document.querySelector('[data-send-queue]'); if(!panel) throw new Error('no queue panel'); const chip=panel.querySelector('[data-queue-choice]'); if(!chip) throw new Error('the row has no choice chip'); if(panel.querySelectorAll('[data-queue-item]').length!==1) throw new Error('the panel must hold exactly one row'); const r=chip.getBoundingClientRect(); const row=panel.querySelector('[data-queue-item]').getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.width<60) throw new Error('the chip is collapsed: '+Math.round(r.width)); if(r.right>row.right+1) throw new Error('the chip overflows the row'); const label=chip.querySelector('button').getAttribute('aria-label'); if(!label) throw new Error('the chip has no change action'); return JSON.stringify({chip:[Math.round(r.width),Math.round(r.height)],change:label}); })()

choice-card-remote.note: 远程桌面 · 同一张卡。远程会话用的是宿主的 transcript 和本机的 composer，卡片由同一份 renderer 画出来，所以样式、字号、留白与本机一致（宽度跟远程输入框同宽）。远程 composer 是纯 textarea、没有 pill，所以已选项走输入框上方的 chip 行——和附件同一个槽位。

steps.tapText: 重画森林图并核对置信区间

steps.eval: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); if(!card) throw new Error('the card did not render in the remote transcript'); card.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); const r=card.getBoundingClientRect(); const chip=document.querySelector('[data-choice-chip]'); if(!chip) throw new Error('no chip above the remote field'); const cr=chip.getBoundingClientRect(); const ta=document.querySelector('form textarea'); if(!ta) throw new Error('the remote composer is not the plain textarea it should be'); const tr=ta.getBoundingClientRect(); if(cr.bottom > tr.top+1) throw new Error('the chip is not above the field: '+Math.round(cr.bottom)+' vs '+Math.round(tr.top)); if(r.bottom > tr.top - 8) throw new Error('the card runs into the composer'); if((ta.value||'').trim()) throw new Error('the remote field must stay empty: '+JSON.stringify(ta.value)); return JSON.stringify({card:[Math.round(r.top),Math.round(r.bottom)],chip:[Math.round(cr.top),Math.round(cr.bottom)],field:[Math.round(tr.top),Math.round(tr.bottom)]}); })()

choice-card-styles.note: 卡片样式的三个方向：同一屏、同一段回复，只换卡片本身。A 分组行带一行说明与编号（推荐）；B 紧凑两行，去掉编号，读起来像短菜单；C 一整排标签，最省高度，但长选项会换行成多段。
choice-card-styles.variantsTitle: 选项卡的三种样式（同一段回复，只换卡片）

steps.eval: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); if(!card) throw new Error('the card did not render'); card.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); const r=card.getBoundingClientRect(); const form=document.querySelector('form').getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.bottom > form.top - 8) throw new Error('the card runs under the composer'); if(r.top < 70) throw new Error('the card is clipped at the top'); const rows=card.querySelectorAll('[data-choice-option]'); if(rows.length!==3) throw new Error('the card draws '+rows.length+' options'); return JSON.stringify({h:Math.round(r.height)}); })()

choice-card-dark.note: 深色外观下的同一张卡：卡片用 surface，分隔用 line-soft，选中行用 accent-soft + accent 描边，chip 与附件同色系。这一屏用来确认它不是只按浅色调的。

steps.eval: (() => { const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); if(!card) throw new Error('no card'); card.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { if(!document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')) throw new Error('the frame is not dark'); const card=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); const r=card.getBoundingClientRect(); const form=document.querySelector('form').getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.bottom > form.top - 8) throw new Error('the card runs under the composer'); const pill=document.querySelector('[data-mention="choice"]'); if(!pill) throw new Error('no answer pill in the editor'); const bg=getComputedStyle(card).backgroundColor; if(bg === 'rgb(255, 255, 255)') throw new Error('the card kept the light surface in a dark frame'); const pbg=getComputedStyle(pill).backgroundColor; if(pbg === 'rgb(232, 240, 255)') throw new Error('the pill kept the light accent-soft in a dark frame'); return JSON.stringify({bg, pillBg:pbg, card:[Math.round(r.top),Math.round(r.bottom)]}); })()

choice-card-rejected.note: 两个探索过但没有采用的做法：左图行尾加了 1/2/3 的数字快捷键（会与输入框里的自由文字冲突），右图卡内加了「自己写…」虚线行（看着像输入框却不可聚焦，且与副标题重复）。截图留证，不实现。

choice-card-phone.note: 手机 · 未选。同一张卡在 390pt 宽下的样子：整卡满宽、行高 44pt 起（可点），选项说明换行而不省略，标题行右侧标单选。

steps.eval: (() => { const label = ['稍后再说', 'Not now'].map(text => document.querySelector(`[aria-label="${text}"]`)).find(Boolean); if (label) label.click(); return label ? 'dismissed the update prompt' : 'no update prompt'; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const cell=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); if(!cell) throw new Error('the phone card did not render'); const r=cell.getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.width < 340) throw new Error('the card is not full width: '+Math.round(r.width)); const rows=[...cell.querySelectorAll('[data-choice-option]')]; if(rows.length!==3) throw new Error('the card draws '+rows.length+' options'); for(const row of rows){ const h=row.getBoundingClientRect().height; if(h < 44) throw new Error('a row is '+Math.round(h)+'pt, under the 44pt target'); } if(document.querySelector('[data-choice-chip]')) throw new Error('nothing is chosen yet'); return JSON.stringify({card:[Math.round(r.top),Math.round(r.bottom),Math.round(r.width)],rows:rows.map(x=>Math.round(x.getBoundingClientRect().height))}); })()

choice-card-phone-chosen.note: 手机 · 已选。选中的行高亮，答案作为 chip 停在输入框上方（与附件同槽位、同高度），输入框保持空——可以直接发，也可以接着写。

steps.eval: (() => { const label = ['稍后再说', 'Not now'].map(text => document.querySelector(`[aria-label="${text}"]`)).find(Boolean); if (label) label.click(); return label ? 'dismissed the update prompt' : 'no update prompt'; })()

steps.tapText: 整理两篇文献的结论对比表

steps.eval: (() => { const cell=document.querySelector('[data-choice-card]'); const chip=document.querySelector('[data-choice-chip]'); if(!cell) throw new Error('no card'); if(!chip) throw new Error('no chip in the dock'); const cr=chip.getBoundingClientRect(); const ta=document.querySelector('textarea'); const tr=ta.getBoundingClientRect(); if(cr.bottom > tr.top+1) throw new Error('the chip is not above the field: '+Math.round(cr.bottom)+' vs '+Math.round(tr.top)); if((ta.value||'').trim()) throw new Error('the field must stay empty: '+JSON.stringify(ta.value)); const picked=[...cell.querySelectorAll('[data-choice-picked]')]; if(picked.length!==1) throw new Error(picked.length+' rows look chosen'); const p=picked[0]; const cs=getComputedStyle(p); if(cs.borderTopColor!=='rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && cs.borderTopStyle!=='none') throw new Error('the chosen row still wears a border: two cues where v2 wants one'); const mark=p.querySelector('[data-choice-picked] > div, div'); const btns=[...chip.querySelectorAll('[aria-label]')].map(b=>getComputedStyle(b.querySelector('svg')).stroke||getComputedStyle(b.querySelector('svg')).color); if(btns.length!==2) throw new Error('the chip must offer edit and remove'); if(btns[0]!==btns[1]) throw new Error('edit and remove use different ink: '+JSON.stringify(btns)); return JSON.stringify({cell:[Math.round(cell.getBoundingClientRect().top),Math.round(cell.getBoundingClientRect().bottom)],chip:[Math.round(cr.top),Math.round(cr.bottom)],field:[Math.round(tr.top),Math.round(tr.bottom)],actions:btns}); })()

choice-card-phone-change.note: 手机 · 改回来。窄屏没有空间在原地展开菜单，铅笔改开底部 sheet：选项仍是 44pt 行，换完即时写回输入框上方的 chip，底稿不丢。

steps.eval: (() => { const label = ['稍后再说', 'Not now'].map(text => document.querySelector(`[aria-label="${text}"]`)).find(Boolean); if (label) label.click(); return label ? 'dismissed the update prompt' : 'no update prompt'; })()

steps.tapText: 整理两篇文献的结论对比表

steps.eval: (() => { const sheet=document.querySelector('[data-choice-sheet]'); if(!sheet) throw new Error('no bottom sheet'); const r=sheet.getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.top < 300) throw new Error('the sheet takes too much of the screen: top '+Math.round(r.top)); const rows=[...sheet.querySelectorAll('[data-choice-option]')]; for(const row of rows){ const h=row.getBoundingClientRect().height; if(h<44) throw new Error('a sheet row is '+Math.round(h)+'pt'); } if(r.bottom < window.innerHeight-10) throw new Error('the sheet does not sit on the bottom edge'); return JSON.stringify({sheet:[Math.round(r.top),Math.round(r.bottom)],rows:rows.length}); })()
